beats.say: Is White Christmas really the best selling song of all time?
According to Guinness World Records, Bing Crosby's 1942 classic is the top selling single worldwide.
But for digital sales, the same source names Spotlight by Xiao Zhan as the best selling ever.
Ed Sheeran's Shape of You is the highest certified single ever, while Whitney Houston holds the female record.
With so many ways to measure, which song would you guess is the true number one?

facts: According to Guinness World Records, the best selling single worldwide is White Christmas by Bing Crosby from 1942
In 2023, Guinness World Records named Spotlight by Xiao Zhan as the best selling digital single of all time
Whitney Houston holds the record for the best selling single by a female artist with I Will Always Love You
Ed Sheeran's Shape of You is the highest certified single ever according to official certifications
